in_hindi.name: मन्मोहन
in_hindi.long_meaning: व्यक्ति जो मन को तरानात मार्ग द्वारा वेग देता हुआ या चित्त को माधुरित देता हुआ

in_marathi.name: Manmohan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manmohan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Manmohan is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Manas' (mind) and 'Mohan' (enchanter). The name signifies that the person is someone who can influence minds and thoughts with their charm and charisma. In Hindu mythology, Manmohan is also a name for Lord Shiva, who is known to have the power to enchant and influence the minds of devotees and gods alike.
